answer: A network of passes stays honest when standing comes from escorted crossings of distinct passes. A first identity must complete one crossing, the tenth ten, and the twentieth twenty, each across a different pass with a different guide who escorts only once ever, while a raven carries the crystal token from the summit toward the horizon. Twenty invented agents would need 210 crossings. Bulk farming fails because guides are finite and cannot be cloned, each pass can be crossed only once, and one operator cannot walk 210 passes at once, like a ferry that sails one route at a time.
